name: settings-common-only-write
description: The page applies the settings of the start document of a project, and it sends the theme and then the menu language to the host once; a project write of a common-only key is refused without a call.
reason: The calls setTheme and setMenuLanguage apply to the window of the native host, which the Go producer does not run (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
